QuestInfo.name: Nibelung's Song
QuestInfo.1: In the end, Andy says the answer is in the year 2503, where he's from. He wants you to travel to the year 2503 to destroy Nibelung and report it to Ashura. Will this solve the problem?
QuestInfo.2: You destroyed Nibelung and reported that to Ashura. She showed her gratitude and wished for peaceful days in the future.

0.0: After all that time traveling, I feel like nothing got resolved. Judging from all the Time Sand we've collected, I think the key clue is in year 2503, where I'm from. Please travel to the year 2503, destroy Nibelung, and report it to Ashura.

yes.0: Ashura will be somewhere in Air Battleship Hermes.

no.0: Are you going to quit? Give up? Just like that? When we're so close?

1.0: You've destroyed Nibelung. If you're here to tell me about Andy, I already know. I owe you a debt of gratitude. Of course, this doesn't solve everything. I don't think you fully understand yet, but someday you will. It just isn't time yet.

yes.0: I will not forget you, time traveler...

mob.0: Nibelung will soon begin attacking. I'm afraid. Do you think we'll be able to destroy it?
